name: Ephemeral Software
description: Software that is generated on-demand by AI agents, performs its task, and then disappears — never stored, versioned, or named. Described as software turning into a liquid that 'drips into every nook and cranny and then evaporates.'

edges.quote: he used an agent to vibe-code a piece of software to talk to the torque wrenches via Bluetooth and record the data in the spreadsheet he uses
ChatGPT writes tens or hundreds of lines of Python to resize images, create a PDF, or extract data from a CSV —and then throws it away, without anyone even having seen the code
